brief: Clear the overgrown shrub cover restricting the airflow path to the rear of the unit and the vegetation encroaching on the compound fence within a metre of the radiators, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity [SOP-011]. Complete work order WO-3182 for the cooling controller, which remains open from last season, as items relating to degraded forced cooling are to be finished before a forecast heat event wherever crew capacity allows [SOP-016].
